accounting.rationale: Original PDF127 lines36-39 combines entity-category definitions, effective-argument rank, a scalar boundary, a deferred-shape cross-reference and declaration syntax. These are not one unrestricted array/descriptor rule.
A dummy data object is one defining category, subject to actual association, presence, attributes and interface rules. It is not an ordinary local variable or a dummy procedure.

Effective argument has the precise15.5.2.4 meaning. A pointer dummy can instead become pointer associated with a nonpointer actual without argument association; do not invent an effective argument for that route.
PENDING the actual associate of a RANK DEFAULT block under11.1.10.3. Not every associate name is assumed-rank; a RANK(n) block gives fixed rank and RANK(*) gives rank-one assumed size.
PENDING complete selector, branch-selection, attribute and construct-lifetime premises from11.1.10 and19.5.1.6. No copied SELECT RANK fixture or no-op classifier is created.

Rank zero is expressly permitted and is retained as a meaningful actual-dummy rank boundary. A scalar effective argument is not an empty rank-one array, and not every array-only intrinsic accepts an ordinary scalar.
ALLOCATABLE assumed-rank bounds/shape follow8.5.8.4 under the actual allocation and association premises. The attribute does not imply an allocated value or available extents.
POINTER assumed-rank bounds/shape follow the canonical pointer mechanisms. A declaration does not establish association, and undefined association is not the same as disassociation.

PENDING exact8.5.8.4 and15.5.2.6-.8 source relations for bounds established by allocation, pointer assignment or valid association, including INTENT(OUT) state changes. No second local bound requirement or new allocation fixture is invented.

PENDING available-property and whole-array/empty-dimension inquiry premises. RANK permission does not legalize unavailable SHAPE/SIZE/LBOUND/UBOUND; zero total size does not normalize every dimension.
Original PDF127 line40 defines the two-dot specifier. Fixed RANK clauses and colon/star forms describe other categories rather than interchangeable spellings.
PDF127 lines41-42 retains the associate-name alternative and the dummy-data-object alternative with the CODIMENSION/VALUE exclusions; p1 supplies the actual assumed-rank associate context.
PDF128 lines1-4 restricts name appearances in designators/expressions with five exception routes. Each route retains its independent intrinsic, argument or construct conditions.
C_LOC is its own named exception, not an intrinsic inquiry. Its target/pointer, type, state, contiguity, nonzero-array and nonzero-character-length premises remain18.2.3.7.
C_SIZEOF keeps18.2.3.8's interoperable type/parameters, allocation/association and assumed-size-forwarding exclusions. The permission is not a byte-width or companion-ABI oracle.
The source says first dummy argument, not necessarily the first written actual argument when keywords reorder correspondence.

PDF128 lines5-8 concerns a qualifying actual array forwarded to an INTENT(OUT) assumed-rank dummy. The actual category/attributes and recipient intent/category are separate premises; no blanket ban on all OUT dummies is inferred.

requirements.title: An assumed-rank declaration uses the two-dot array specifier
requirements.source: 8.5.8.7 p1 declaration clause and R827, physical PDF127, printed113, lines39-40
requirements.definition: An assumed-rank entity is declared with an array-spec that is the assumed-rank-spec '..'. This is not a fixed RANK clause, a deferred/assumed-shape colon list, or an assumed-size star form. The declaration must still satisfy the entity-role and permitted-use constraints.

pending.two-dot-admission: PENDING complete explicit-interface ordinary INTEGER dummy x(..), with the only body inquiry being permitted RANK(x). Preserve S6_2_1_001_valid__assumed_rank as the original lexical double-dot run/positive-control; any reuse retains its owner and role rather than cloning the program.
pending.entity-context-source: PENDING ordinary, eligible ALLOCATABLE and POINTER assumed-rank dummy declarations under their actual argument/state rules, plus the separately defined RANK DEFAULT associate. A different valid array-spec is not a syntax error just because assumed rank was intended; components retain R740.
pending.malformed-dot-control: PENDING a complete ordinary dummy declaration x(...) repaired only to x(..), after excluding valid alternative array-spec parses. The report must identify the malformed assumed-rank specifier, not unsupported language facilities, another declaration or generic EOF. Implement only when legitimate source origins/disjoint anchors can be expressed without line coalescing or span widening.

requirements.oracle: Finite complete grammar admissions and one narrowly repaired malformed declaration. Syntax admission is distinct from observing effective rank or available shape.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Required reporting capability does not require fatal exit, exact English or a printed R/C code. Unsupported-feature messages, source echoes, ICE/verifier/resource failures and wrong-source recovery are excluded. No canonical witness is cloned or retagged to bypass evidence-role requirements.

requirements.title: Assumed-rank entities have restricted roles and dummy attributes
requirements.definition: An assumed-rank entity is an associate name or a dummy data object without CODIMENSION or VALUE. The defining associate context is a SELECT RANK RANK DEFAULT block. These conditions do not prohibit otherwise eligible ALLOCATABLE, POINTER or OPTIONAL dummies, nor do they make every associate name or procedure dummy assumed-rank.

pending.dummy-admission: PENDING a complete ordinary INTEGER assumed-rank dummy and eligible OPTIONAL, ALLOCATABLE and POINTER dummy contexts with explicit interfaces. Specify no prohibited VALUE/CODIMENSION, and do not inquire unavailable properties merely because a declaration is admitted.
pending.rank-default-associate: PENDING a valid SELECT RANK on a present assumed-rank dummy with a RANK DEFAULT branch, observing the branch and permitting only C840-compliant uses of its associate. Preserve the distinct RANK(n) fixed-rank and RANK(*) assumed-size categories; no new no-op classifier or copied Clause11 case.
pending.value-excluded: PENDING ordinary INTEGER,VALUE::x(..) in a genuine dummy/interface context, repaired only by removing VALUE. Do not use TYPE(*), whose C714 restriction independently excludes VALUE, or combine this with POINTER/ALLOCATABLE conflicts.
pending.codimension-excluded: PENDING ordinary INTEGER x(..)[*] in a complete dummy/interface context, repaired only by removing the coarray specification. Keep any coarray-configuration support gate explicit; an unsupported coarray configuration or a nonmatching caller is not a C839 report.
pending.scalar-type-attribute-boundaries: PENDING exact source/admission relations for scalar effective arguments, assumed-type versus typed/polymorphic dummies, and eligible pointer/allocatable states. TYPE(*) has additional C714-C716 restrictions; a scalar invocation does not remove the declaration-level VALUE/CODIMENSION conditions.

requirements.oracle:
Three focused role/attribute negatives with minimal valid repairs, and complete admitted dummy/associate contexts. Report causes and legitimate source origins are independent of message wording or printed constraint identifiers.

C839 finite assumed-rank usage oracle: a complete external subroutine declares ordinary INTEGER subject(..) without a dummy argument. Its sole repair inserts subject into the existing empty dummy list, preserving every other byte. Both cases contain no executable operation or competing attribute. The invalid requires a located complete assumed-rank/nondummy cause at the actual staged declaration on line3; the repair must produce an object and remains a compile positive control.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
No forced fatal exit, unsupported-feature credit, source-echo evidence, unrelated shape/type recovery or broadened source span. Keep role-dependent reuse pending until the actual evidence mechanism is supported and independently adjudicated; do not alter validators or original roles.

C839 finite assumed-rank usage boundaries: only the selected exclusion facet is represented, not the whole constraint or every admitted dummy/use category. Other pending facets, oracle paragraphs, control designations and raw review states remain independently managed. C839 dummy-admission and C840 first-inquiry-dummy plans remain separate: the two repairs do not close their broader attribute/state matrices. No new runtime RANK, output-value, payload, shape/bounds, VALUE, C/coarray, SELECT RANK, canonical reuse or SourceUses credit is created. Reporting capability prescribes neither fatal status, printed rule identifiers nor standardized English. Exact calibrated causes admit ordinary error reports even with status0, but no warning/portability allowance is invented. Silence, generic feature unavailability, wrapped or quoted examples, source echoes, wrong subjects/files/lines, parser recovery and Internal/ASR/crash/resource failures do not qualify. Real reference failures remain failures; Flang's actual f2018 observations are never relabelled as f2023. Generation approves nothing and never changes reviews, links, SourceUses, the execution inventory or baseline.

requirements.title: An assumed-rank variable name has five qualified use routes
requirements.definition: In a designator or expression, an assumed-rank variable name appears only as an actual corresponding to an assumed-rank dummy, the argument of ISO_C_BINDING C_LOC or C_SIZEOF, the first dummy argument of an intrinsic inquiry, or a SELECT RANK selector. These are permitted name-use routes, not waivers of intrinsic type/state/presence requirements, additional assumed-type rules or actual/dummy association restrictions.

pending.assumed-rank-forwarding: PENDING a complete module/program with typed INTEGER x(..) forwarded to a same-type assumed-rank recipient through an explicit interface, observing actual recipient RANK with independent literals. Preserve incoming/outgoing intent and definability, type/kind and C841 conditions. A permitted forwarding spelling is not universal actual-argument compatibility.
pending.first-inquiry-dummy: PENDING direct RANK, and allocated/associated or ordinary-present SHAPE/SIZE/LBOUND/UBOUND admissions on the actual assumed-rank object. RANK's permission does not authorize payload or unavailable shape. An attempt in a later inquiry dummy position requires a separate exact causal relation, not credit for an unrelated scalar/type defect.
pending.keyword-correspondence: PENDING a defined rank-one INTEGER actual and SIZE(DIM=1,ARRAY=x) in the assumed-rank observer. ARRAY is the first dummy argument even though written second; require the independent extent3 where observed. Do not conflate keyword correspondence with lexical argument order or silently import the different TYPE(*) C715 wording.
pending.c-loc-source: PENDING a complete typed INTEGER(C_INT) TARGET assumed-rank observer with a live target actual, using C_LOC only after its actual scalar/array, allocation/association, nonzero size/length and contiguity requirements are established. A scalar admission and a nonzero contiguous array admission are distinct. No address equality, C_PTR layout, byte-width or dereference oracle is supplied by this name-use permission.
pending.c-sizeof-source: PENDING a complete typed interoperable INTEGER(C_INT) assumed-rank context satisfying18.2.3.8, including its exclusion of assumed-size forwarding and inactive allocation/association. Numeric C_SIZEOF observations require genuine companion/type/result-kind evidence; do not guess C_SIZE_T, sizeof(int), byte width or header substitutions. Missing evidence is a pending interface gate, not an optional skip for required behavior.
pending.select-rank-selector: PENDING a present ordinary INTEGER assumed-rank selector in a complete SELECT RANK, with independently counted branch selection and defined payload accessed only through an appropriate fixed-rank associate. In RANK DEFAULT, the associate remains assumed-rank and C840 still restricts its uses. TYPE(*) has its own additional C715 limitations.
pending.fixed-rank-forwarding-excluded: PENDING x(..) passed directly to a fixed-rank ordinary INTEGER sink whose only body operation is RANK on its dummy. Repair only the sink declaration to assumed-rank, keeping a complete interface and a compatible scalar caller. A particular runtime rank does not legalize the original name use. Bind the call/declaration origins and actual recipient-category cause without widening spans.
pending.presence-state-and-sentinels: PENDING direct PRESENT on an accessible OPTIONAL assumed-rank dummy and ordinary block-guarded uses only when present; an IF block, not assumed logical short circuit, protects further inquiries. RANK on a present unallocated allocatable or disassociated pointer has different premises from ASSOCIATED and shape inquiries. Ordinary assumed-size forwarding may give SHAPE=[2,-1], SIZE(last)=-1 and total SIZE=-2; these are intrinsic conventions, not recovered last extent or sequence size.
pending.assumed-type-intersection: PENDING exact intersection with C714-C716. Preserve C714_valid__assumed_rank and C716_valid__assumed_rank as original run/positive-controls; their rank observations do not justify role retagging. Existing C715 bounds and C_LOC witnesses are assumed-shape and scalar respectively, not assumed-rank observations. C716's assumed-size TYPE(*) forwarding exclusion remains, and C_SIZEOF/SELECT RANK permission here does not override TYPE(*) restrictions.

requirements.oracle:
Complete permitted-use admissions and focused minimal-repair negatives with source-specific causes. Any runtime property observation uses the actual assumed-rank object and independent literals, while numeric interoperability and source/role dependencies remain explicit gates.

C840 finite assumed-rank usage oracle: a complete program passes a defined ordinary INTEGER scalar to an internal explicit-interface INTEGER INTENT(IN) x(..) observer. Direct PRINT of x on line10 is repaired only to PRINT of RANK(x), preserving the declaration, caller and all other bytes. The invalid requires a complete prohibited assumed-rank-use cause at that actual staged output-list item; the repair must produce an object and remains a compile positive control. Direct RANK(x) uses the first inquiry dummy, not a fixed-rank observer or a constructor. The measured target message names precisely the assumed-rank PRINT prohibition. Its exact phrase containing 'not supported' is not generalized into permission for generic unimplemented-feature reports.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Required diagnostic capability is not fatal-exit, exact-English or printed-code policy. No unsupported-feature/ICE/verifier/resource/echo/recovery credit, guessed descriptor/address result, forbidden inquiry or simulated origin/disjoint-anchor mechanism. Intrinsic and ordinary procedure requirements retain their canonical owners.

C840 finite assumed-rank usage boundaries: only the selected exclusion facet is represented, not the whole constraint or every admitted dummy/use category. Other pending facets, oracle paragraphs, control designations and raw review states remain independently managed. C839 dummy-admission and C840 first-inquiry-dummy plans remain separate: the two repairs do not close their broader attribute/state matrices. No new runtime RANK, output-value, payload, shape/bounds, VALUE, C/coarray, SELECT RANK, canonical reuse or SourceUses credit is created. Reporting capability prescribes neither fatal status, printed rule identifiers nor standardized English. Exact calibrated causes admit ordinary error reports even with status0, but no warning/portability allowance is invented. Silence, generic feature unavailability, wrapped or quoted examples, source echoes, wrong subjects/files/lines, parser recovery and Internal/ASR/crash/resource failures do not qualify. Real reference failures remain failures; Flang's actual f2018 observations are never relabelled as f2023. Generation approves nothing and never changes reviews, links, SourceUses, the execution inventory or baseline.

requirements.title: Qualifying actual arrays forwarded to an OUT assumed-rank dummy exclude four type properties
requirements.definition: If an assumed-size array, or a nonallocatable nonpointer assumed-rank array, is an actual argument corresponding to an INTENT(OUT) assumed-rank dummy, that actual is not polymorphic or finalizable, has no allocatable ultimate component, and is not of a type with specified default initialization. The actual category/attributes, array premise and recipient category/intent are all retained. This is not a blanket exclusion of those types from every assumed-rank declaration or OUT call.

pending.polymorphic-actual-exclusion: PENDING two complete forwarding families: a CLASS(t) INOUT assumed-size x(*) and a nonallocatable nonpointer CLASS(t) INOUT x(..), each passed to a CLASS(t) OUT y(..). Type t has no FINAL, allocatable ultimate component or default initialization. Repair only recipient OUT to INOUT. Keep the upstream dummy non-OUT to avoid C836, and do not use TYPE(*) with its independent restrictions.
pending.finalizable-actual-exclusion: PENDING corresponding TYPE(t) forwarding families for a type with one valid module FINAL procedure having an INOUT dummy, but no allocatable ultimate component or default initialization. Change only recipient OUT to INOUT. The invalid recipient is not the final subroutine; C791's OUT-finalizer violation and original finalization fixtures retain their owners.
pending.allocatable-ultimate-exclusion: PENDING both actual-array families with a nonpolymorphic nonfinalizable type containing an INTEGER ALLOCATABLE ultimate component, including a separately reviewed nested nonpointer/nonallocatable component route. No component-initialization is specified. Repair only recipient OUT to INOUT; implicit unallocated status is not specified default initialization.
pending.default-initialized-actual-exclusion: PENDING both actual-array families with a plain type containing INTEGER payload=17 and no FINAL or allocatable ultimate component. Repair only recipient OUT to INOUT. Apply the actual direct-component default-initialization definition; do not use an initializer on an unrelated caller variable as the predicate.
pending.recipient-intent-controls: PENDING complete IN/INOUT recipient controls retaining each actual category and type property, and an ordinary INTEGER OUT assumed-rank recipient with a qualifying actual that has none of the excluded properties. Compile admissions do not prove finalization/default-initialization runtime effects or waive definability.
pending.pointer-allocatable-category-boundary: PENDING exact boundaries when the assumed-rank actual has POINTER or ALLOCATABLE: it is not the nonallocatable-nonpointer actual branch. This does not legalize every call; matching attributes/type parameters, association/allocation and OUT entry effects remain15.5.2.6-.8. No old bounds or pointer status may be sampled after they become unavailable or undefined.
pending.scalar-empty-and-origin-gates: PENDING independent source adjudication of the array premise versus scalar effective arguments; do not claim that one scalar invocation repairs an otherwise prohibited forwarding declaration or impose a blanket scalar ban. Zero-size arrays remain arrays. Each type-property negative/control must bind the actual, call and OUT recipient's legitimate source origins and exact cause; no source-line coalescing, broad spans, generic type/OUT messages or role-schema workaround.

requirements.oracle: Four isolated actual-type predicates across both stated actual-array categories, with complete source-valid OUT-to-INOUT repairs and precise recipient/category controls. Actual/dummy terms and declaration-site causes are not interchangeable.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No mandatory trap, fatal status, English text or printed constraint code. Unsupported polymorphism/finalization/components, unrelated type/rank errors, source echoes and ICE/recovery cannot establish C841. Scalar/array and origin/role questions remain explicit source/mechanism gates; no broad negative twins for pure effects are invented.

requirements.title: A dummy's assumed rank derives from its effective argument and can be zero
requirements.source: 8.5.8.7 p1 effective-rank and scalar clauses, physical PDF127, lines36-37
requirements.definition: The rank of an assumed-rank dummy data object is assumed from its effective argument, including rank zero. Effective argument means argument association under15.5.2.4; the distinct pointer-dummy/nonpointer-actual route is not assigned a fabricated effective argument. Rank does not by itself establish available shape, allocation, association or defined payload.

pending.allocated-associated-effective-rank: PENDING separate matching ALLOCATABLE and POINTER assumed-rank observers with allocated or associated effective arguments of known rank1/2. Check state before bounds/shape/data, use literal rank expectations and retain type/kind/parameter/lifetime rules. Ordinary nonpointer and pointer/allocatable lower-bound mechanisms remain their canonical owners.
pending.inactive-state-rank-gate: PENDING matching ALLOCATABLE and POINTER dummy/actual contexts where an unallocated array or explicitly disassociated array pointer can be a present effective argument. A direct RANK result can still be observed from the actual fixed-rank declaration under16.1/16.9.171; do not forward through an ordinary nonoptional nonallocatable/nonpointer helper or read shape/payload. ASSOCIATED cannot examine undefined association status; OPTIONAL absence has separate PRESENT and call restrictions.
pending.canonical-rank-observation-reuse: PENDING exact source/case relation to S7_5_6_2_001_valid__final_process_assumed_rank: its existing run/effect records direct RANK(self)=0/1/2 for scalar, vector and empty matrix finalization, with literal event expectations. Preserve owner, inputs, roles and receipts; any runtime-effect link needs independent source review and must not duplicate execution. C714/C716 and lexical positive-controls remain role-gated rather than retagged.
pending.nonpointer-actual-pointer-dummy-source: PENDING the INTENT(IN) pointer-dummy route of15.5.2.8 with a valid live nonpointer target. Under15.5.2.4p5 that dummy is not argument associated and the actual is not its effective argument. Qualify any rank/bound observation from the actual governing association rules before reuse; no universal effective-argument claim or fabricated association is added here.

requirements.oracle:
Actual assumed-rank observers with complete explicit interfaces, lawful argument/state contexts and independent literal results. Meaningful existing run/effect observations can be source-linked only after canonical review; source and role gates give no execution or facet-completion credit.

S8.5.8.7-001 ordinary rank effect family: two complete run/effect/f2023 programs use an internal explicit-interface observer with INTEGER INTENT(IN) x(..). Each observer obtains its result directly from RANK(x), never from a constructor, copied data object or fixed-rank observer. The ordinary program passes a defined named scalar, vector(3) and matrix(2,3) to the same observer with independent literal rank expectations0/1/2. The zero-size program passes named a(0) and b(0,3), expecting literal ranks1/2 without any element access. Present nonpointer/non-VALUE dummy and nonpointer actual entities are argument associated under15.5.2.4p3; that associated entity is the effective argument underp6. Each call checks rank and its independent visit ordinal, counts the actual observed rank category, and returns to an independently incremented caller counter. Final visit/category/return/observer-check and caller-check totals precede exact completion stdout, empty stderr and normal exit0. Full-parent one-span wrong-oracle probes target every guard, separately for each repeated observer activation, and each completion literal. Passing current parent plus the intended runtime guard or output failure is necessary for sensitivity credit.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
No compile-only substitute for required runtime behavior, fixed-rank or constructor RANK proxy, affected-descriptor expectation, C_SIZEOF/address model, undefined value or assumed-size sentinel recovery. Role, causal-origin and processor-interface evidence must be genuinely supported rather than simulated.

S8.5.8.7-001 ordinary rank effect boundaries: only scalar-and-array-effective-ranks and zero-size-array-rank are represented. Zero element count does not remove declared dimensions or make an array scalar.19.6.2's always-defined empty arrays are not a presence, allocation or pointer-association equivalence. Nonempty actuals and all counters are explicitly defined before use. No SIZE, SHAPE, LBOUND, UBOUND, payload, SELECT RANK, POINTER, ALLOCATABLE, OPTIONAL, assumed-size, assumed-type, polymorphism, coarray, C, CONTIGUOUS, VALUE, ASYNCHRONOUS or VOLATILE mechanism is used. No shape/bounds facet is claimed. The pointer-dummy/nonpointer-actual exception is not imported. Lexical double-dot, C714/C716 and finalization witnesses keep their original owners and positive-control/effect roles; no case is cloned or retagged as reuse. All unselected pending/control/review state remains independently managed. Compile/link failures, failed parents, preempting guards, crashes and resource/time failures cannot establish probe sensitivity; blocked plans remain explicit. Guard markers are program output, not mandated processor diagnostic wording or ERROR STOP exit codes. Runtime requirements are not weakened for unsupported processors. Source, fixture, native-mode and inventory adjudications remain distinct; no approval, baseline, link or SourceUses renewal is made.
